messages:
Priya: Quick design review — spotted a couple of small but important UX/accessibility issues in the model catalog compare flow. Can we sync?

Marco: Yep, send screenshots or a short list and I’ll triage.

Priya: Two main things: 1) keyboard focus on compare rows is hard to track when badges are present (focus ring gets obscured by badge). 2) 'Performance' badges read inconsistently — some say "latency 12ms" others say "fast" with no numeric.

Jamie: I noticed that too. On narrow view the badge overlays the row action area and makes the hit target unclear.

Alex: For the latency badges we can show a compact numeric + shorthand label (e.g., "12ms · Fast") so both humans and screen readers get consistent info.

Casey: Accessibility nit: badges should have aria-labels like "latency 12 milliseconds, fast" and not rely on visual cues alone. Also focus order: make sure the row container gets focus before any internal buttons.

Marco: Agree. Current DOM places badge before the row title which is why focus ring gets clipped. Quick fix: move badge node after title in DOM but keep visual order with CSS (flex-order).

Jamie: That helps keyboard outlines. But we should also increase color contrast for badges — the pale green on light gray fails WCAG AA at small sizes.

Priya: Good call. Can we get two alternatives? One high-contrast palette and one with subtle border + transparent fill so it’s not a blob covering text?

Marco: I'll prototype both. Quick question on copy: should pinning a model version be called "Pin to session" or "Pin version"? Current tests show confusion around permanence.

Jamie: Suggestion: "Pin version (applies to this compare session)" as microcopy. Longer text is clunky in the button though. Maybe tooltip copy clarifies.

Alex: Behavior note: when you pin a version in a compare session, do we persist that across browser refresh? If yes, we should surface the persistence level in the UI via a short tag. If no, say "temporary pin" somewhere.

Priya: UX decision: for v1 we keep it session-scoped (not persisted). We need microcopy to set expectations and an analytics event: compare.pin.clicked with scope=session.

Casey: Accessibility keyboard flows: ensure pin toggles are reachable by Enter/Space and announce state changes via aria-pressed or aria-describedby. Also, when a pin is active, include an offscreen message: "Version pinned for this session."

Marco: Implementation plan: a) move badge in DOM, b) add aria-label and aria-pressed, c) alternate visual styles (two tokens), d) tooltip microcopy for pin. I'll open a PR after prototyping.

Jamie: For animations — avoid heavy entrance motion when toggling badges or pin icons; reduce to 80ms fade to avoid motion sickness and keep perceived performance high.

Priya: Acceptance criteria for this ticket: 1) keyboard focus ring visible on focused row in all breakpoints, 2) badges meet contrast or use border variant, 3) latency badges show numeric + label, 4) pin action has tooltip copy and fires analytics, 5) screen reader announces pin state.

Marco: Sounds good. I'll add a checklist in the PR description. Putting a small Figma link here: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/model-catalog-compare-badges (mock).

Jamie: Thx — I'll update the design tokens and add the microcopy strings.

Priya: Can we aim to have a dev PR by EOD Wednesday and a design review on Thursday?

Marco: EOD Wednesday works for a draft.

Casey: I can do an a11y review after the PR is up.

design-bot: Reminder: Please attach screenshots to the PR and include keyboard-only testing steps. :robot_face:

Priya: Great — thanks everyone. I'll create the ticket and assign.
